resolved_params.warmup_scope: No discarded samples. Identical source/dependency pre-read before every sample; diagnostic compilation is separate from this target-build population.
resolved_params.invalidation: mtime only; source bytes remain at the exact clean commit; require observed importer fan-out
resolved_params.build_storage: Fresh owned build at /dev/shm/intrinsic-build011-measure; identical source/build paths across arms.
resolved_params.dependency_state: identical preinstalled vcpkg packages, no package installation during sampling
resolved_params.operating_system_cache: input pre-read, no cache flushing, no cold-filesystem claim
resolved_params.memory_measurement: GNU time maximum single-process RSS, not aggregate concurrent memory
resolved_params.critical_path: Ninja target DAG weighted by unfiltered per-invocation timings; unmatched meta-edges reported
resolved_params.summary: Median and range of two samples per arm. Acceptance requires >=15% shared-header improvement with nonoverlapping ranges, reduced clean compiler-duration sum, <=2% clean regression and <=50% regression for each normal, density and descriptor codec-edit scenario. Include complete closure, all three receiving owners and links. Local descriptive comparison only.
resolved_params.sample_sequence: Configure, clean target build, no-op, normal/density/descriptor codec edits at the actual implementation owner in each arm, shared JSON declaration-header edit, unchanged common helper implementation edit. Fresh build per sample; mtime-only edits.
resolved_params.noise_scope: Normal desktop host; no CPU affinity/governor/turbo control. No competing compilation or tests; source inspection and remote review may run. Local descriptive comparison, not an isolated-machine or statistical claim.
resolved_params.configure_measurement: initial configure only; source iteration cohort deliberately excludes the already-measured reconfigure scenario.
resolved_params.source_scope: Exact before/after commits; ten point config implementation bodies move into three ordinary translation units with globally attached public functions. Config records retain named-module ownership. Benchmark runner supports per-arm relocated paths and verifies complete declared producer sets. Other JSON families remain unchanged.
